remarks: Opportunity to own a freestanding commercial property along Long Ridge Road in Stamford. 2661 Long Ridge Road offers a versatile building situated on a generously paved site with ample parking and outdoor area. The property is currently tenant occupied, providing existing rental income and an opportunity for an investor or future owner-user.  Conveniently located along the well-traveled Long Ridge Road corridor with easy access to surrounding Stamford neighborhoods, the Merritt Parkway, and the New York state line. The existing layout and substantial on-site parking offer flexibility and potential for a variety of commercial uses, subject to zoning and municipal approvals.  Owner financing is available to qualified buyers. Buyer to perform their own due diligence regarding zoning, permitted uses, property condition, and any municipal requirements or approvals.
